title: Moliya va iqtisod tili
goal_uz: Dars oxirida moliyaviy hisobot lug‘atini ishlatasiz, bozor harakatini by/to va aniq fe’llar bilan tasvirlaysiz, sabab va oqibatni to‘g‘ri bog‘lovchilar bilan ifodalaysiz va moliyaviy yangilikni faktlar, sabablar va manbali prognozlar bilan qisqa xulosa qilasiz.

scenes.title: Moliya va iqtisod tili
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda IT va texnologiya tilini ko‘rib chiqdik. Bugun pul olamiga o‘tamiz. Dars oxirida siz moliyaviy hisobotdagi asosiy so‘zlarni ishlatasiz, bozor harakatini aniq fe’llar bilan tasvirlaysiz, iqtisodiy sabab va oqibatni to‘g‘ri bog‘lovchilar bilan ifodalaysiz va qisqa moliyaviy yangilikni o‘qib, o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan xulosa qilasiz. Ish joyida ham, IELTS yoki Cambridge C1 imtihonida ham bu mavzu juda tez-tez uchraydi. Ingliz moliya tili aniqlikni yaxshi ko‘radi: „went down“ o‘rniga „fell by two per cent“ deyish professional eshitiladi.
scenes.say: Good morning, and welcome back. In the last lesson we looked at the language of technology. Today we turn to money: how companies report their results, how markets move, and how journalists explain why.
scenes.say_uz: Xayrli tong, qaytganingizdan xursandman. Oxirgi darsda texnologiya tilini ko‘rdik. Bugun pulga o‘tamiz: kompaniyalar natijalarini qanday hisobot qiladi, bozorlar qanday harakat qiladi va jurnalistlar buni qanday tushuntiradi.

scenes.title: Moliyaviy hisobotlar lug‘ati
board: cash flow statement = cash in / cash out

examples.t: Total assets exceeded liabilities by four million pounds.
examples.uz: Jami aktivlar majburiyatlardan to‘rt million funtga oshib ketdi.

examples.t: Revenue rose, but net profit fell because of higher costs.
examples.uz: Tushum o‘sdi, lekin xarajatlar oshgani uchun sof foyda kamaydi.

examples.t: Operating cash flow remained positive throughout the year.
examples.uz: Yil davomida operatsion pul oqimi musbat bo‘lib qoldi.

scenes.say_native: Kompaniya odatda uchta hisobot e’lon qiladi. Balans — „balance sheet“ — bir kunga holatni ko‘rsatadi: nimaga egasiz, ya’ni „assets“, nimani qarzdorsiz, ya’ni „liabilities“, farqi esa „equity“, egalik kapitali. Daromadlar hisoboti — „income statement“ yoki „profit and loss“, qisqacha P&L — davr ichida tushumdan sof foydagacha yo‘lni ko‘rsatadi. Pul oqimi hisoboti — „cash flow statement“ — haqiqiy kirgan va chiqqan pulni kuzatadi. Muhim: foyda va pul bir narsa emas. Kompaniya foydada bo‘lib, hisobida pul qolmasligi mumkin. Britaniyada „turnover“ ham tushum ma’nosida ishlatiladi, Amerikada ko‘proq „revenue“ va „sales“.
scenes.say: A company usually publishes three statements. The balance sheet shows what it owns, its assets, and what it owes, its liabilities, with the difference called equity. The income statement, or profit and loss account, moves from revenue down to net profit. The cash flow statement tracks the actual cash coming in and going out.
scenes.say_uz: Kompaniya odatda uchta hisobot e’lon qiladi. Balans u nimaga egaligini, ya’ni aktivlarni, va nimani qarzdorligini, ya’ni majburiyatlarni ko‘rsatadi; farqi egalik kapitali deyiladi. Daromadlar hisoboti tushumdan sof foydagacha boradi. Pul oqimi hisoboti esa haqiqiy kirim va chiqimni kuzatadi.

scenes.title: Xato: revenue va profit
board: ✗ Our profit was ten million this year (sales haqida)
✓ Our revenue was ten million; profit was two million

examples.t: Gross profit is revenue minus the direct cost of goods sold.
examples.uz: Yalpi foyda tushumdan sotilgan tovarning bevosita tannarxini ayirganga teng.

examples.t: Net profit is what remains after tax and interest.
examples.uz: Sof foyda soliq va foizlardan keyin qoladigan summadir.

scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida „daromad“ so‘zi ham tushumni, ham foydani bildirishi mumkin. Shuning uchun inglizcha gapirganda ko‘pchilik „profit“ deb yuboradi, aslida tushumni nazarda tutadi. Bu jiddiy xato: investor „profit“ eshitsa, xarajatlar ayirilgan sof natijani tushunadi. Ketma-ketlik shunday: „revenue“ — tushum; undan sotilgan tovar tannarxi ayirilsa „gross profit“; yana boshqa xarajatlar, foiz va soliq ayirilsa „net profit“. „Margin“ esa foydaning tushumga foizdagi nisbati. Gapirishdan oldin o‘zingizdan so‘rang: men pulning qaysi bosqichini aytyapman?
scenes.say: A very common slip is to say profit when you mean revenue. Revenue is the total money earned from sales. Gross profit is revenue minus the direct cost of goods sold. Net profit is what remains after all costs, interest and tax. Margin is profit expressed as a percentage of revenue.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘p odamlar tushum haqida gapirib, foyda deb yuboradi. Tushum — sotuvdan tushgan jami pul. Yalpi foyda — tushumdan sotilgan tovarning bevosita tannarxini ayirganda qoladigan summa. Sof foyda — barcha xarajatlar, foiz va soliqdan keyin qolgani. Marja — foydaning tushumga nisbati, foizda.

scenes.title: Mashq: hisobot so‘zlari
board: 1) What shows what a firm owns and owes?
2) Which figure comes first: revenue or net profit?
3) Can a profitable firm run out of cash?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savolga to‘liq gap bilan baland ovozda javob bering. Birinchisi: kompaniya nimaga ega va nimani qarzdorligini qaysi hisobot ko‘rsatadi? Ikkinchisi: daromadlar hisobotida avval qaysi ko‘rsatkich keladi, tushummi yoki sof foydami? Uchinchisi: foydali kompaniyada pul tugab qolishi mumkinmi? Har bir javobda hisobot nomini aniq ayting. Pauza bosing yoki bir necha soniya o‘ylang, keyin keyingi sahnada javobingizni tekshiring.
scenes.say: Three quick questions. Which statement shows what a firm owns and owes? Which figure comes first in the income statement, revenue or net profit? And can a profitable company still run out of cash? Answer aloud in full sentences.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta tezkor savol. Kompaniya nimaga ega va nimani qarzdorligini qaysi hisobot ko‘rsatadi? Daromadlar hisobotida avval qaysi ko‘rsatkich keladi? Foydali kompaniya hamon pulsiz qolishi mumkinmi? To‘liq gap bilan baland ovozda javob bering.

scenes.title: Javoblar: hisobotlar
board: 2) revenue, then net profit at the bottom

examples.t: The balance sheet lists assets and liabilities.
examples.uz: Balans aktivlar va majburiyatlarni sanab beradi.

scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi savol: balans, „the balance sheet“. Ikkinchi: tushum eng yuqorida turadi, sof foyda esa eng pastda — shuning uchun „bottom line“ iborasi ham sof natija ma’nosida ishlatiladi. Uchinchi: ha, mumkin. Masalan, mijozlar hisob-fakturalarni kech to‘lasa, hisobotda foyda ko‘rinadi, lekin kassada pul yetmaydi. Shu sababli tahlilchilar uchala hisobotni birga o‘qiydi. Agar sizning javoblaringiz shu mazmunda bo‘lsa, yaxshi, agar „profit“ va „cash“ ni almashtirib yuborgan bo‘lsangiz, bir marta takrorlang.
scenes.say: The balance sheet answers the first question. In the second, revenue sits at the top and net profit at the bottom. And yes, a firm can show a profit while cash is short, for instance when customers pay their invoices late. That is why analysts read all three statements together.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi savolga balans javob beradi. Ikkinchisida tushum yuqorida, sof foyda pastda turadi. Va ha, kompaniya foyda ko‘rsatib, pulsiz qolishi mumkin, masalan mijozlar hisob-fakturalarni kech to‘lasa. Shuning uchun tahlilchilar uchala hisobotni birga o‘qiydi.

scenes.title: Bozorlar va tendensiyalar
board: rose by 3% · fell to 1.2 · edged up · slumped

examples.t: Shares rallied by three per cent after the announcement.
examples.uz: E’londan keyin aksiyalar uch foizga ko‘tarildi.

examples.t: The market has been volatile since the rate decision.
examples.uz: Foiz stavkasi qarori e’lon qilinganidan beri bozor beqaror.

examples.t: Bond yields edged up to four per cent.
examples.uz: Obligatsiyalar daromadliligi to‘rt foizgacha biroz ko‘tarildi.

scenes.say_native: Bozorni tasvirlashda fe’l va predlog ikkalasi muhim. „Bull market“ — o‘sayotgan bozor, „bear market“ — tushayotgan bozor. „By“ o‘zgarish miqdorini bildiradi: „shares rose by three per cent“ — uch foizga. „To“ esa yetib kelgan darajani: „rose to four pounds“ — to‘rt funtgacha. Fe’l kuchni ko‘rsatadi: „edge up“ — salgina ko‘tarilish, „rally“ — kuchli tiklanish, „slump“ yoki „plunge“ — keskin tushish. „Volatile“ — beqaror, narxlar tez-tez tebranadi. Uzoq o‘sishdan keyingi qisqa pasayish „correction“ deyiladi. Tendensiyani aytganda raqamni ham qo‘shing, shunda gapingiz aniq bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Markets rise in a bull market and fall in a bear market. Notice the prepositions. Shares rose by three per cent, a change, but they rose to four pounds, a level. Verbs show strength: edge up is slight, rally is strong, slump and plunge are sharp falls. A short fall after a long rise is called a correction.
scenes.say_uz: Bozor bull bozorida o‘sadi, bear bozorida tushadi. Predloglarga e’tibor bering. Aksiyalar uch foizga ko‘tarildi, bu o‘zgarish, lekin to‘rt funtgacha ko‘tarildi, bu daraja. Fe’llar kuchni ko‘rsatadi: edge up — salgina, rally — kuchli, slump va plunge — keskin tushish. Uzoq o‘sishdan keyingi qisqa pasayish correction deyiladi.

scenes.title: Xato: by va to, increase fe’li

examples.t: Unemployment fell from six per cent to five.
examples.uz: Ishsizlik olti foizdan beshga tushdi.

examples.t: Profits grew by a fifth over the quarter.
examples.uz: Foyda chorak davomida beshdan bir qismga o‘sdi.

scenes.say_native: Uzbek tilida „8 foizga o‘sdi“ deymiz va qo‘shimchaning o‘zi yetadi. Inglizchada predlogni tanlash kerak, va shu yerda xato ko‘p chiqadi: „increased on 8%“ noto‘g‘ri. O‘zgarish miqdori uchun „by“, boshlanish va tugash nuqtasi uchun „from“ va „to“. „Unemployment fell from six per cent to five“ — ishsizlik olti foizdan beshga tushdi. Ot shaklida esa „a fall of eight per cent“ deymiz, bu yerda „of“ ishlatiladi: „an increase of“, „a rise of“. Fe’l bilan „by“, ot bilan „of“ — shu ikki qoidani eslab qolsangiz, xatoning ko‘pi yo‘qoladi.
scenes.say: Learners often write increased on eight per cent. The correct choice is by for the size of the change, from and to for the starting point and the end point. So: unemployment fell from six per cent to five. Profits grew by a fifth. Also remember that the fall of eight per cent is a noun phrase, but to fall by eight per cent is a verb phrase.
scenes.say_uz: O‘quvchilar ko‘pincha sakkiz foizga o‘sdi deb noto‘g‘ri predlog qo‘yadi. To‘g‘risi: o‘zgarish miqdori uchun by, boshlang‘ich va oxirgi nuqta uchun from va to. Ishsizlik olti foizdan beshga tushdi. Foyda beshdan bir qismga o‘sdi. Ot bilan esa of ishlatiladi: sakkiz foizlik pasayish.

scenes.title: Mashq: bozorni tasvirlang
scenes.say_native: Uchta harakatni fe’l va to‘g‘ri predlog bilan tasvirlang. Birinchisi: neft narxi sakson dollardan sakson besh dollarga o‘tdi. Ikkinchisi: kompaniya aksiyalari bir kunda o‘n foizga arzonlashdi. Uchinchisi: foiz stavkalari to‘rt foizdan to‘rt yarim foizga ko‘tarildi. Har bir gapda „by“ yoki „from … to“ ishlating va kuchni ko‘rsatadigan fe’l tanlang. Javobingiz keyingi sahnada tekshiriladi.
scenes.say: Describe three movements using a verb and the right preposition. One: the oil price went from eighty to eighty-five dollars. Two: a company's shares dropped ten per cent in a single day. Three: interest rates moved from four per cent to four and a half.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta harakatni fe’l va to‘g‘ri predlog bilan tasvirlang. Neft narxi sakson dollardan sakson besh dollarga o‘tdi. Kompaniya aksiyalari bir kunda o‘n foizga arzonlashdi. Foiz stavkalari to‘rt foizdan to‘rt yarim foizga o‘tdi.

scenes.title: Javoblar: bozor tasviri
board: Shares plunged by ten per cent in one day.
Rates rose by half a point, to 4.5%.

examples.t: Oil edged up from eighty to eighty-five dollars a barrel.
examples.uz: Neft bir barrel uchun sakson dollardan sakson besh dollargacha biroz ko‘tarildi.

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar: neft sakson dollardan sakson besh dollargacha „edged up“ — chunki o‘zgarish kichik. Aksiyalar bir kunda o‘n foizga „plunged“ — chunki tushish keskin. Stavkalar yarim foiz bandga, „by half a percentage point“, ko‘tarilib, to‘rt yarim foizga yetdi. Boshqa fe’llar ham to‘g‘ri bo‘ladi, agar predlog mos kelsa: o‘zgarishga „by“, yangi darajaga „to“. Foiz va foiz bandini adashtirmang: „percentage point“ stavkaning o‘zi qancha surilganini ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say: Here are model answers. Oil edged up from eighty to eighty-five dollars. Shares plunged by ten per cent in a single day. Rates rose by half a percentage point, to four and a half per cent. Other verbs are fine too, as long as the preposition matches: by for the change, to for the new level.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy javoblar. Neft sakson dollardan sakson besh dollargacha biroz ko‘tarildi. Aksiyalar bir kunda o‘n foizga keskin tushdi. Stavkalar yarim foiz bandga ko‘tarilib, to‘rt yarim foizga yetdi. Boshqa fe’llar ham mumkin, faqat predlog mos bo‘lsin: o‘zgarishga by, yangi darajaga to.

scenes.title: Iqtisodda sabab va oqibat
board: X leads to Y · X results in Y
Y is due to X · Y stems from X
as a result · consequently · hence · thereby

examples.t: Rising energy prices led to higher inflation across the region.
examples.uz: Energiya narxlarining oshishi butun mintaqada inflyatsiyaning ortishiga olib keldi.

examples.t: The slowdown was largely due to weaker consumer demand.
examples.uz: Sekinlashuv asosan iste’mol talabining zaiflashuvi bilan bog‘liq edi.

examples.t: Interest rates went up; consequently, mortgage lending fell.
examples.uz: Foiz stavkalari oshdi; natijada ipoteka kreditlari kamaydi.

scenes.say_native: Sabab-oqibatni ikki yo‘nalishda aytish mumkin. Sababdan boshlasangiz: „X leads to Y“, „X results in Y“, „X triggers Y“ — X Y ga olib keladi. Oqibatdan boshlasangiz: „Y is due to X“, „Y stems from X“, „Y is the result of X“. Ikki gap orasida „as a result“, „consequently“, „hence“ ishlating — „hence“ rasmiyroq. Kuchga e’tibor bering: iqtisodda sabab kamdan-kam yagona bo‘ladi. Shuning uchun bitta omil bir nechtasidan biri bo‘lsa, „contributed to“ — hissa qo‘shdi, deyish aniqroq. „Led to“ esa kuchliroq, deyarli bevosita bog‘liqlikni anglatadi.
scenes.say: There are two directions. Start from the cause: X leads to Y, X results in Y, X triggers Y. Start from the effect: Y is due to X, Y stems from X, Y is the result of X. Between sentences use as a result, consequently or hence. Be careful with strength. Say contributed to when a cause is only one of several.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki yo‘nalish bor. Sababdan boshlash: X Y ga olib keladi, X Y ni keltirib chiqaradi. Oqibatdan boshlash: Y X tufayli, Y X dan kelib chiqadi. Gaplar orasida as a result, consequently yoki hence ishlating. Kuchga ehtiyot bo‘ling: sabab bir nechtasidan biri bo‘lsa, contributed to deng.

scenes.title: Xato: because of va because
board: ✗ Because of prices rose, demand fell
✓ Because of the price rise, demand fell

examples.t: Owing to supply shortages, car prices climbed sharply.
examples.uz: Yetkazib berish tanqisligi tufayli avtomobil narxlari keskin ko‘tarildi.

examples.t: Because the currency weakened, imports became costlier.
examples.uz: Valyuta zaiflashgani uchun import qimmatlashdi.

scenes.say_native: Eng keng tarqalgan xato — „because of“ dan keyin to‘liq gap qo‘yish. Qoida: „because“ dan keyin ega va fe’lli gap keladi: „because prices rose“. „Because of“, „due to“, „owing to“ dan keyin esa ot yoki ot birikmasi: „because of rising prices“. O‘zbekchada „narxlar oshgani uchun“ va „narxlar oshishi tufayli“ shakllari bir-biriga yaqin, shuning uchun farq sezilmaydi. Yana bir tuzoq — korrelyatsiya. Ikki ko‘rsatkich birga o‘zgargani birining ikkinchisiga sabab ekanini isbotlamaydi. Yaxshi iqtisodchi „is associated with“ — bog‘liq, deb ehtiyotkor yozadi.
scenes.say: Remember the grammar after each linker. Because is followed by a clause with a subject and a verb. Because of, due to and owing to are followed by a noun phrase. So we say: because prices rose, but because of rising prices. A second trap is correlation. Two things moving together do not prove that one caused the other.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir bog‘lovchidan keyingi grammatikani eslang. Because dan keyin ega va fe’lli gap keladi. Because of, due to va owing to dan keyin ot birikmasi. Ikkinchi tuzoq — korrelyatsiya: ikki ko‘rsatkich birga harakatlansa ham, biri ikkinchisini keltirib chiqarganini isbotlamaydi.

scenes.title: Mashq: sababni bog‘lang
board: 1) fuel costs rose → airlines raised fares
3) central bank cut rates → borrowing grew (hence)
scenes.say_native: Har bir juftlikni bitta gapga bog‘lang. Birinchisi: yoqilg‘i xarajatlari oshdi, aviakompaniyalar chipta narxini ko‘tardi — „led to“ ishlating. Ikkinchisi: foyda kamaydi, sababi talabning zaifligi — „due to“ ishlating. Uchinchisi: markaziy bank stavkani pasaytirdi va qarz olish ko‘paydi — „hence“ ishlating, sababdan boshlang. Predlog va bog‘lovchidan keyingi shaklni tekshiring: ot birikmasi kerakmi yoki to‘liq gap?
scenes.say: Link each pair of facts in one sentence. One: fuel costs rose, so airlines raised their fares. Use led to. Two: profits fell, caused by weak demand. Use due to. Three: the central bank cut rates and borrowing grew. Use hence, and begin with the cause.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir juftlikni bitta gapga bog‘lang. Yoqilg‘i xarajatlari oshdi, aviakompaniyalar chipta narxini ko‘tardi: led to ishlating. Foyda kamaydi, sababi talabning zaifligi: due to ishlating. Markaziy bank stavkani pasaytirdi, qarz olish ko‘paydi: hence ishlating.

scenes.title: Javoblar: sabab va oqibat
board: Higher fuel costs led to higher fares.
The fall in profits was due to weak demand.
The bank cut rates; hence, borrowing grew.

examples.t: Weak demand pushed profits down.
examples.uz: Talabning zaifligi foydani pasaytirdi.

scenes.say_native: Mumkin bo‘lgan javoblar: „Higher fuel costs led to higher fares“ — „led to“ dan keyin ot birikmasi. „The fall in profits was due to weak demand“ — „due to“ dan keyin „weak demand“, ya’ni ot birikmasi, gap emas. „The central bank cut rates; hence, borrowing grew“ — „hence“ ikkinchi gapni boshlaydi, oldida odatda nuqtali vergul turadi. Agar siz „because“ ishlatgan bo‘lsangiz ham mayli, lekin bu mashqda aniq bog‘lovchilar so‘ralgan edi. Rasmiy hisobotda „hence“ va „consequently“ ni kamroq, ammo o‘rinli ishlating.
scenes.say: Possible answers. Higher fuel costs led to higher fares. The fall in profits was due to weak demand. The central bank cut rates; hence, borrowing grew. Notice that due to is followed by a noun phrase, and that hence normally sits at the start of a second clause, often after a semicolon.
scenes.say_uz: Mumkin javoblar. Yoqilg‘i xarajatlarining oshishi chipta narxining oshishiga olib keldi. Foydaning kamayishi talabning zaifligi bilan bog‘liq edi. Markaziy bank stavkani pasaytirdi; shu sababli qarz olish ko‘paydi. Due to dan keyin ot birikmasi, hence esa ikkinchi gap boshida keladi.

scenes.title: Moliyaviy yangiliklarni o‘qish
board: hedges: is expected to · is set to · reportedly
attribution: analysts say · according to the report

examples.t: Shares slump as investors fear a slowdown.
examples.uz: Investorlar sekinlashuvdan xavotirda, aksiyalar keskin tushmoqda.

examples.t: The bank is expected to raise rates, analysts say.
examples.uz: Tahlilchilarning aytishicha, bank stavkani oshirishi kutilmoqda.

examples.t: Profits are set to double next year, according to the forecast.
examples.uz: Prognozga ko‘ra, kelasi yil foyda ikki baravar oshishi kutilmoqda.

scenes.say_native: Moliyaviy sarlavha qisqa bo‘ladi va o‘tgan voqeani ham hozirgi zamonda beradi: „Shares slump as investors fear a slowdown“. Artikl ko‘pincha tashlab ketiladi. Maqola matnida esa fakt va kutilmani ajrating. Fakt o‘tgan zamonda: „profits fell“. Kutilma „is expected to“, „is set to“, „is forecast to“ bilan: „the bank is expected to raise rates“. Manba ko‘rsatiladi: „analysts say“, „according to the report“. O‘qiyotganda uchta savol bering: bu fakt yoki prognozmi, kim aytyapti, va raqam nimani o‘lchayapti? „Reportedly“ — „xabar qilinishicha“ — tasdiqlanmagan ma’lumotni bildiradi.
scenes.say: Financial headlines are short and use the present simple for past events: Shares slump as investors fear a slowdown. Articles then separate fact from expectation. Facts use the past tense. Forecasts use is expected to, is set to or is forecast to. Sources are named with analysts say or according to. Learn to spot who is making the claim.
scenes.say_uz: Moliyaviy sarlavhalar qisqa va o‘tgan voqealar uchun hozirgi oddiy zamondan foydalanadi. Maqola matni fakt bilan kutilmani ajratadi. Faktlar o‘tgan zamonda. Prognozlar is expected to, is set to yoki is forecast to bilan. Manbalar analysts say yoki according to bilan ko‘rsatiladi. Da’voni kim aytayotganini payqashni o‘rganing.

scenes.title: Xato: prognozni fakt deb aytish
board: ✓ Profits are forecast to double, analysts say

examples.t: The company reportedly plans to cut two hundred jobs.
examples.uz: Xabar qilinishicha, kompaniya ikki yuzta ish o‘rnini qisqartirishni rejalashtirmoqda.

examples.t: Analysts warn that growth could stall.
examples.uz: Tahlilchilar o‘sish to‘xtab qolishi mumkinligidan ogohlantirmoqda.

scenes.say_native: Qisqacha xulosa yozayotganda eng katta xato — prognozni fakt qilib berish. „Profits will double“ — ishonchli eshitiladi, lekin manba yo‘q. „Profits are forecast to double, analysts say“ — bu baho ekani ko‘rinadi. Ehtimol uchun „could“ va „may“ ishlating, fikr egasini ko‘rsatish uchun „warn“, „claim“, „predict“ kabi fe’llar yaxshi. Farqni sezing: „warn“ — ogohlantirmoq, „claim“ — da’vo qilmoq, bunda siz da’voga qo‘shilmayotganingizni ham bildirasiz. O‘zbekchada „aytishlaricha“ deymiz, inglizchada esa shu ma’noni fe’lning o‘zi tanlab beradi.
scenes.say: When you summarise a news item, do not turn a forecast into a fact. Profits will double sounds certain. Profits are forecast to double, analysts say, shows that it is an estimate. Use modals like could and may for possibilities, and reporting verbs such as warn, claim and predict to show who holds the view.
scenes.say_uz: Yangilikni xulosa qilayotganda prognozni faktga aylantirmang. Foyda ikki baravar oshadi, deyish ishonchli eshitiladi. Foyda ikki baravar oshishi prognoz qilinmoqda, deyish esa bu baho ekanini ko‘rsatadi. Ehtimol uchun could va may, fikr egasi uchun warn, claim, predict kabi fe’llardan foydalaning.

scenes.title: Mashq: sarlavhani qayta yozing
board: Headline: Retailer posts record loss as costs bite
Forecast: next year to see recovery, says CFO
scenes.say_native: Quyidagi yangilikni ikkita to‘liq gapda qayta yozing. Sarlavha: „Retailer posts record loss as costs bite“ — chakana savdo kompaniyasi xarajatlar sabab rekord zarar e’lon qildi. Moliya direktori kelasi yil tiklanish kutilayotganini qo‘shimcha qiladi. Zararni o‘tgan zamonda, tiklanishni „is expected to“ bilan yozing va prognoz manbasini ko‘rsating. Sarlavhadagi hozirgi zamonni o‘tgan zamonga aylantirishni unutmang.
scenes.say: Rewrite this news in two full sentences. The headline says: Retailer posts record loss as costs bite. The finance director adds that a recovery is expected next year. Use the past tense for the loss, and is expected to for the recovery. Name the source of the forecast.
scenes.say_uz: Yangilikni ikkita to‘liq gapda qayta yozing. Sarlavha: chakana savdo kompaniyasi xarajatlar sabab rekord zarar e’lon qildi. Moliya direktori kelasi yil tiklanish kutilayotganini aytadi. Zararni o‘tgan zamonda, tiklanishni is expected to bilan yozing va manbani ko‘rsating.

scenes.title: Javoblar: sarlavha va xulosa
board: The retailer reported its biggest ever loss because costs rose.
A recovery is expected next year, the finance director said.

examples.t: The retailer reported a record loss after costs climbed.
examples.uz: Xarajatlar oshgach, chakana savdo kompaniyasi rekord zarar haqida xabar berdi.

scenes.say_native: Namuna: „The retailer reported a record loss after its costs climbed. A recovery is expected next year, the finance director said.“ Birinchi gap — o‘tgan zamondagi fakt. Ikkinchi gap — manbasi ko‘rsatilgan kutilma. Sarlavhadagi „posts“ hozirgi zamonda edi, biz uni „reported“ ga aylantirdik. „Costs bite“ — xarajatlar sezilarli ta’sir qilmoqda, bu so‘zma-so‘z emas, ibora; xulosada uni oddiyroq „costs climbed“ qilib berdik. Zaifroq variant — „a recovery will come“, chunki u manbasiz va juda ishonchli eshitiladi. Siz ham shunday ikki qadamni bajaring: avval faktni, keyin kutilmani yozing.
scenes.say: A model summary: The retailer reported a record loss after its costs climbed. A recovery is expected next year, the finance director said. The first sentence is a fact in the past tense. The second is an expectation with a named source. A weaker version would say a recovery will come, with no source at all.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy xulosa. Chakana savdo kompaniyasi xarajatlari oshgach, rekord zarar haqida xabar berdi. Moliya direktori aytishicha, kelasi yil tiklanish kutilmoqda. Birinchi gap o‘tgan zamondagi fakt, ikkinchisi manbasi ko‘rsatilgan kutilma. Zaifroq variant manbasiz tiklanish keladi, deb aytardi.

scenes.title: Tinglash 1: investorlar uchrashuvida
board: A: Revenue rose by six per cent.
A: Mainly due to higher raw material costs.
B: Is that expected to continue?
scenes.say_native: Birinchi suhbatni tinglang. Bu investorlar bilan telefon uchrashuvi. Kompaniya vakili aytadi: tushum olti foizga o‘sib, ikki yuz million bo‘ldi, lekin operatsion marja o‘n bir foizgacha toraydi, asosan xomashyo xarajatlari oshgani sababli. Investor so‘raydi: bu bosim davom etadimi? Javob: rahbariyat yilning ikkinchi yarmida xarajatlar pasayishini kutmoqda, biroq ehtiyotkor. Diqqat qiling: „rose by“, „narrowed to“, „due to“ va „expects … to ease“ — bugungi to‘rt qoliptan to‘rttasi ham shu yerda.
scenes.say: Thanks for joining the call. Revenue rose by six per cent to two hundred million, but operating margin narrowed to eleven per cent. That was mainly due to higher raw material costs. Do you expect that pressure to continue? Management expects costs to ease in the second half, though we remain cautious.
scenes.say_uz: Qo‘ng‘iroqda qatnashganingiz uchun rahmat. Tushum olti foizga o‘sib, ikki yuz million bo‘ldi, lekin operatsion marja o‘n bir foizgacha toraydi. Bu asosan xomashyo xarajatlari oshgani bilan bog‘liq edi. Bu bosim davom etadi deb o‘ylaysizmi? Rahbariyat ikkinchi yarimyillikda xarajatlar pasayishini kutmoqda, biroq biz ehtiyotkormiz.

scenes.title: Suhbat 1 bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1) By how much did revenue rise?
2) What happened to the margin, and why?
scenes.say_native: Suhbat bo‘yicha uchta savolga ingliz tilida javob bering. Birinchisi: tushum necha foizga o‘sdi? Ikkinchisi: operatsion marjaga nima bo‘ldi va sababi nima edi? Uchinchisi: rahbariyat ikkinchi yarimyillikda xarajatlar haqida nimani kutmoqda? Javobda „by“, „to“ va „due to“ ni to‘g‘ri ishlating.
scenes.say: Three questions about the call. By how much did revenue rise? What happened to the operating margin, and what was the reason? And what does management expect about costs in the second half?
scenes.say_uz: Suhbat bo‘yicha uchta savol. Tushum necha foizga o‘sdi? Operatsion marjaga nima bo‘ldi va sababi nima edi? Rahbariyat ikkinchi yarimyillikda xarajatlar haqida nimani kutmoqda?

scenes.title: Javoblar: suhbat 1
board: costs expected to ease, but cautious
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Tushum olti foizga o‘sdi — „by six per cent“. Marja o‘n bir foizgacha toraydi — „narrowed to eleven per cent“, sababi xomashyo xarajatlarining oshishi. Rahbariyat xarajatlar ikkinchi yarimda pasayishini kutadi, lekin ehtiyotkor — ya’ni prognoz umidli, ammo kafolatlanmagan. E’tibor bering: „to“ marjaning yangi darajasini, „by“ tushumning o‘zgarish miqdorini ko‘rsatdi. Shuning uchun gapni ham shu tartibda qurish kerak. Agar bu javoblarni ayta olgan bo‘lsangiz, investor suhbatida o‘zingizni ishonchli his qilasiz.
scenes.say: Revenue rose by six per cent. The margin narrowed to eleven per cent, and the cause was higher raw material costs. Management expects costs to ease in the second half, but it stays cautious, so the outlook is hopeful rather than certain.
scenes.say_uz: Tushum olti foizga o‘sdi. Marja o‘n bir foizgacha toraydi, sababi xomashyo xarajatlarining oshishi. Rahbariyat ikkinchi yarimda xarajatlar pasayishini kutadi, lekin ehtiyotkor, ya’ni prognoz umidli, ammo aniq emas.

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: tahlilchilar muhokamasi
board: B: Because inflation surprised on the upside.
A: So the central bank may hold rates.
B: Analysts say a cut is unlikely before spring.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi suhbat — ikki hamkasbning ertalabki muhokamasi. Birinchisi: kechasi obligatsiya daromadliligi sakradi, chunki inflyatsiya kutilganidan yuqori chiqdi. Natijada aksiyalar tebrandi va valyuta mustahkamlandi. Shuning uchun markaziy bank stavkani yaqin orada pasaytirishi ehtimoldan yiroq. Tahlilchilar bahorgacha pasaytirish dargumon, deydi. Eshiting: „because“ dan keyin to‘liq gap, „as a result“ gap boshida, „unlikely“ va „improbable“ ehtimolni ehtiyotkor ifodalaydi.
scenes.say: Did you see the markets this morning? Bond yields jumped overnight because inflation came in higher than expected. As a result, stocks wobbled, and the currency strengthened. So the central bank is unlikely to cut rates soon. Analysts say a cut before spring looks improbable.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun ertalab bozorlarni ko‘rdingizmi? Obligatsiya daromadliligi kechasi sakradi, chunki inflyatsiya kutilganidan yuqori chiqdi. Natijada aksiyalar tebrandi, valyuta esa mustahkamlandi. Shuning uchun markaziy bank yaqin orada stavkani pasaytirishi dargumon. Tahlilchilar bahorgacha pasaytirish ehtimoldan yiroq, deydi.

scenes.title: Suhbat 2 bo‘yicha savollar
board: 2) What happened to stocks and currency?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi suhbat bo‘yicha savollarga javob bering. Kechasi nima sakradi va nega? Aksiyalar va valyutaga nima bo‘ldi? Tahlilchilar stavkani pasaytirish haqida nima deydi? Javobingizda „because“ yoki „as a result“ ishlating va tahlilchilarni manba sifatida ko‘rsating.
scenes.say: Questions about the second conversation. What jumped overnight, and why? What happened to stocks and to the currency? And what do analysts say about a rate cut?
scenes.say_uz: Ikkinchi suhbat bo‘yicha savollar. Kechasi nima sakradi va nega? Aksiyalar va valyutaga nima bo‘ldi? Tahlilchilar stavkani pasaytirish haqida nima deydi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: suhbat 2
board: bond yields; inflation higher than expected
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Obligatsiya daromadliligi sakradi, sababi inflyatsiya kutilganidan yuqori edi — „because“ va to‘liq gap. Natijada aksiyalar tebrandi, valyuta esa mustahkamlandi — „as a result“. Tahlilchilar bahorgacha pasaytirish dargumon deydi. Bundan chiqadigan xulosa: arzonroq kredit kutganlar uchun xabar yomon. Bunday „ma’no chiqarish“ ham yangilikni o‘qishning bir qismi: raqamning o‘zi emas, uning kimga ta’siri muhim. Endi shu ko‘nikmalarni birlashtiradigan yakuniy topshiriqqa o‘tamiz.
scenes.say: Bond yields jumped because inflation was higher than expected. As a result, stocks wobbled while the currency strengthened. Analysts say a cut before spring is improbable, so the news is bad for borrowers hoping for cheaper loans.
scenes.say_uz: Obligatsiya daromadliligi sakradi, chunki inflyatsiya kutilganidan yuqori edi. Natijada aksiyalar tebrandi, valyuta esa mustahkamlandi. Tahlilchilar bahorgacha pasaytirishni ehtimoldan yiroq deydi, ya’ni arzonroq kredit kutganlar uchun xabar yomon.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: ovozli xulosa
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Qisqa yangilikni tasavvur qiling: avtomobil ishlab chiqaruvchining foydasi po‘lat narxi oshgani sababli o‘n ikki foizga kamaydi, tahlilchilar esa kelasi yil mo‘tadil tiklanishni kutmoqda. Uni uchta gapda ovoz chiqarib xulosa qiling: bitta fakt raqam bilan, bitta sabab, bitta manbali kutilma. Bugungi qoliplardan foydalaning: „fell by“, „due to“ yoki „because of“, „is expected to“. Tayyor bo‘lgach, keyingi sahnada namunani tinglang.
scenes.say: Final task. Imagine a short news item: a car maker's profits fell by twelve per cent because of rising steel prices, and analysts expect a modest recovery next year. Summarise it aloud in three sentences: one fact, one cause, one expectation with a source.
scenes.say_uz: Yakuniy topshiriq. Avtomobil ishlab chiqaruvchining foydasi po‘lat narxi oshgani sababli o‘n ikki foizga kamaydi, tahlilchilar esa kelasi yil mo‘tadil tiklanishni kutmoqda. Uni uch gapda ovoz chiqarib xulosa qiling: fakt, sabab, manbali kutilma.

scenes.title: Namuna xulosa

examples.t: The carmaker saw profits fall by twelve per cent.
examples.uz: Avtomobil ishlab chiqaruvchining foydasi o‘n ikki foizga kamaydi.

scenes.say_native: Namuna: birinchi gap — fakt: „profits fell by twelve per cent“. Ikkinchi — sabab: „due to higher steel prices“, bu yerda „due to“ dan keyin ot birikmasi keldi. Uchinchi — manbali kutilma: „analysts expect a modest recovery“. Oxirida men shartni ham qo‘shdim: prognoz xomashyo narxlari qanchalik tez barqarorlashishiga bog‘liq. Bu ehtiyotkorlik professional uslubning belgisi. Sizning variantingiz boshqa so‘zlardan iborat bo‘lishi mumkin, lekin tuzilma shu bo‘lsa, topshiriq bajarilgan: fakt, sabab, kutilma. Uyga vazifada xuddi shu tuzilmani haqiqiy yangilikka qo‘llaysiz.
scenes.say: The carmaker's profits fell by twelve per cent. The drop was due to higher steel prices. Analysts expect a modest recovery next year, but the forecast depends on how quickly input costs settle.
scenes.say_uz: Avtomobil ishlab chiqaruvchining foydasi o‘n ikki foizga kamaydi. Pasayish po‘lat narxining oshishi bilan bog‘liq edi. Tahlilchilar kelasi yil mo‘tadil tiklanishni kutmoqda, lekin prognoz xomashyo narxlari qanchalik tez barqarorlashishiga bog‘liq.

scenes.title: Bugungi dars xulosasi
board: rose by / rose to · rally · slump
led to · due to · because of · hence
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Birinchi: tushum va foyda boshqa-boshqa narsa, balans, daromad va pul oqimi hisobotlari esa kompaniyaning uch xil suratini beradi. Ikkinchi: bozor harakatida „by“ o‘zgarish miqdori, „to“ yangi daraja, fe’l esa kuchni ko‘rsatadi. Uchinchi: sabab-oqibatda „led to“, „due to“, „hence“ va „because of“ dan keyin ot birikmasi kelishini unutmang. To‘rtinchi: yangilikda fakt bilan prognozni ajrating va manbani ayting. Shu to‘rtta narsa C1 darajadagi moliya suhbatining asosi.
scenes.say: Let us pull it together. Revenue is not profit. Use by for the size of a change and to for the new level. After because of use a noun phrase. And in the news, separate facts from forecasts and name your sources.
scenes.say_uz: Jamlaymiz. Tushum foyda emas. O‘zgarish miqdori uchun by, yangi daraja uchun to ishlating. Because of dan keyin ot birikmasi keladi. Yangilikda esa faktni prognozdan ajrating va manbani ayting.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Source named · no forecast as fact
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa: haqiqiy moliyaviy yangilik toping va uni uch-to‘rt gapda ingliz tilida xulosa qiling. Xulosada raqamli fakt, sabab va manbasi ko‘rsatilgan kutilma bo‘lsin. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: prognozni faktdek yozmagan bo‘lsangiz va „by“ hamda „to“ ni to‘g‘ri ishlatgan bo‘lsangiz. Yozganingizni ovoz chiqarib o‘qing. Keyingi darsda marketing va reklama tilini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework is to find a real financial news item and summarise it in three or four sentences. Include a fact with a number, a cause, and an expectation with its source. Next lesson: the language of marketing and advertising. See you there.
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifangiz: haqiqiy moliyaviy yangilik topib, uni uch-to‘rt gapda xulosa qiling. Raqamli fakt, sabab va manbali kutilma bo‘lsin. Keyingi dars: marketing va reklama tili. Ko‘rishguncha.

homework_uz: Haqiqiy moliyaviy yangilik toping va uni uch-to‘rt gapda ingliz tilida xulosa qiling: raqamli fakt, sabab va manbasi ko‘rsatilgan kutilma bo‘lsin. Prognozni fakt deb yozmang. Keyingi dars: marketing va reklama tili.

quiz.q: Which statement shows what a company owns and owes?
Unemployment fell ___ six per cent ___ five.
quiz.why_uz: Boshlang‘ich va oxirgi nuqta uchun from … to.

quiz.q: Which phrase needs a noun phrase after it?
quiz.why_uz: „Due to“ dan keyin ot birikmasi keladi; „because“ dan keyin gap.

quiz.q: Revenue minus the direct cost of goods sold is ___.
quiz.why_uz: Yalpi foyda — tushum minus sotilgan tovar tannarxi.

quiz.q: Which verb describes a sharp fall?

quiz.why_uz: „Led to“ dan keyin natija ot birikmasi keladi.

quiz.q: Which sentence correctly reports a forecast?
options: Profits are forecast to double, analysts say.
quiz.why_uz: Prognoz is forecast to bilan, manba bilan beriladi.

options: Because of rising prices, demand fell.
Because of prices rose, demand fell.

quiz.q: A short fall after a long rise in prices is called a ___.
quiz.why_uz: Correction — uzoq o‘sishdan keyingi qisqa pasayish.
